meta.name: receiving-code-review
meta.description: Use when receiving code review feedback, before implementing suggestions, especially if feedback seems unclear or technically questionable - requires technical rigor and verification, not performative agreement or blind implementation

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审慎处理代码审查反馈，验证后再实施
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果收到代码审查意见时想先验证再修改
copy.tagline_en: Handle code review feedback with verification before implementation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to verify code review feedback before implementing changes

howto.what: 收到代码评审意见后,Claude 先读完并复述需求、对照代码库核实,再逐条实现并测试;对含糊或存疑的意见先提问或据理反驳,不说「你说得对」「好建议」这类客套话。
howto.when: 当你把代码评审意见或 PR 评论交给 Claude、准备照它改代码时接管,尤其意见含糊或技术上存疑时。

say.text: 这是评审意见,先别动手,逐条讲你的判断
say.note: 会先核实再回应,不直接改

say.text: 第 4、5 条我看不懂,怎么办?
外部评审让我加个指标接口,先查查有没有人调用
say.note: 会搜代码库,无人用则按 YAGNI 建议删

howto.what_en: On code review feedback, Claude reads it fully, restates the requirement, verifies against the codebase, and implements one item at a time with tests. Unclear or wrong points get questions or pushback, not praise.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you hand Claude code review comments or PR feedback to act on, especially when the feedback is unclear or technically questionable.

say_en.text: Here's the review—don't edit yet; walk me through your call on each point
I don't follow items 4 and 5 — what should I do?
An external reviewer wants a metrics endpoint; check if anything calls it first
say_en.note: Greps usage, may suggest YAGNI removal
